title: A Unified Framework for Implicit Sinkhorn Differentiation
tldr_zh: 用隐式函数定理统一 Sinkhorn 层梯度，同时可微 cost 与边缘，内存 O(n²) 且梯度误差有界
tldr_en: Unified implicit differentiation for Sinkhorn layers, jointly differentiating cost and marginals with O(n²) memory and bounded gradient error
